title: Free game idea: Devil Dice (Xi) adapted for mobile without the avatar. Would you play it?
author: Dependent_Degree1129
selftext:
Devil Dice / Bombastic is an absolute masterpiece, but nobody ever adapted it properly for touchscreens. Here's the idea, free for anyone to build:

Drop the little avatar completely. Direct touch only.

* You swipe a die to roll it 90 degrees onto an empty adjacent tile (classic D6 logic: opposite sides sum to 7).
* Group N dice showing N on top (two 2s, three 3s... six 6s).
* While they slowly sink, you frantically roll more matching dice into the group to keep the chain alive.

Without the avatar running around, the travel time disappears. It turns the game into a pure, super fast dual-thumb spatial puzzler.

What do you think? Does losing the character ruin what made Devil Dice stressful, or does direct touch make the puzzle mechanics ten times better? Would you play this?
